sketches.mechanism: Receiving from a closed channel succeeds immediately forever, yielding the zero value even after the sender is gone.
sketches.resonance: Absence keeps answering, but only with emptiness.
sketches.draft:
package main
func main() {
	ch := make(chan struct{})
	close(ch)
	<-ch
	<-ch
}

sketches.mechanism: An ensure block runs even when the method has already returned.
sketches.resonance: Leaving does not prevent the final obligation from being kept.

sketches.mechanism: A linked process receives an exit signal when its partner exits abnormally, unless it explicitly traps exits.
sketches.resonance: What is truly linked cannot fall alone.
sketches.draft:
main() ->
  spawn_link(fun() ->
    receive never -> ok end
  end),
  exit(gone).
